Deep jade green printed frame, pale mint paper center with an abstract sharp white talisman brush silhouette and a couple of geometric strokes, curled small silver upper-left edge. Preserve original green flat paper silhouette and pale center; do not make a blue orb, ring, flower, thick book or crown. Style: authentic low-resolution 32x32 logical-pixel sprite shown enlarged, clear chunky square pixel clusters, navy outline, green/mint highlights, tiny amber accent if needed. Isolated centered object with generous clear transparent margin. No readable text, watermark, frame, scene, smooth rendering, or anti-aliasing. Actually transparent background.
